components.name: Risk Zone (Critical)
components.description: Inline flat-tint highlight over a source sentence, keyboard-operable, expands its field note on activation.
components.html: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time...
components.css: .ds-zone { padding: 0 0.08em; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-zone-critical { background: rgba(179,27,35,0.16); } .ds-zone-critical:hover, .ds-zone-critical:focus-visible { background: rgba(179,27,35,0.26); } .ds-zone-critical:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C5C8A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Note
components.description: Expand/collapse detail card revealed by a risk zone: why-flagged plus counter-offer, shown one at a time.
components.html:
Why flagged: Critical

Client can end the engagement at will with no cure period.

Counter-offer

Either party may terminate upon fifteen (15) days' written notice.
components.css: .ds-field-note { background: #EAE2D1; border-radius: 4px; padding: 18px 20px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(42,39,31,0.05); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-note-row { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-field-note-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-field-note-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #55503F; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field-note-text { font-size: 0.96rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; color: #2A271F; }

components.name: Severity Legend
components.description: Bordered legend list mapping severity tier to shape+color and plain description; shape (triangle/diamond/circle) is redundant with color.
components.html:
• Critical: direct or foregone-income exposure
  • Moderate: real, lesser exposure
  • Worth noting: one-sided, not dangerous
components.css: .ds-legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(42,39,31,0.16); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #2A271F; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,39,31,0.16); } .ds-legend li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

components.name: Rail Item Button
components.description: Legend-style flag entry in the sticky rail; active state syncs with the you-are-here marker via IntersectionObserver.
components.css: .ds-rail-btn { width: 100%; text-align: left; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 10px 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-btn:hover { background: #EAE2D1; } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C5C8A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-sev { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #55503F; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-rail-label { font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.35; color: #2A271F; }

components.css: .ds-briefing { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,39,31,0.16); padding: 28px clamp(20px,4vw,56px) 22px; background: #F3EEE2; } .ds-brand { font-family: Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #2A271F; } .ds-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #7F1219; margin: 18px 0 8px; } .ds-summary { max-width: 74ch; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.12rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #2A271F; } .ds-tally { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #55503F; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }

narrative.overview: Redline renders a legal document as terrain rather than as a list of chat-bot flags. Danger is a place you can point to, not a badge floating beside a paragraph: risk sits directly over the source sentence that caused it, shaded by severity the way a trail map shades a slope. Safe ground stays neutral ink on parchment; only the hazard-tint zones and the sparing hazard-red accent break the calm. The system is deliberately unglamorous where it needs to be legible — body prose, quoted clauses, and counter-offers run in a plain system-ui workhorse face so the words a user must trust are never stylized — and reserves the designed Overpass grotesque and JetBrains Mono for wayfinding scaffolding (headings, labels, legend, coordinates, tallies) that frames the document without competing with it. This is a light-only, code-shipped world (no dark mode this round; the parchment ground is treated as structural, not a theme option). It carries no drawn shadows as a device: the one shadow in the build is a 1px ambient hairline under the field-note card, not a hard offset or neobrutalist block shadow — this is not that kind of world.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment ground with hairline ink-brown contour rules; one hazard red reserved for danger and the legend
Two-voice type system: a designed grotesque (Overpass) for wayfinding scaffolding, a plain system-ui stack for document prose and quoted legal text
Risk zones as flat graduated-opacity red tints laid directly over source sentences — a deliberate legibility adaptation, not a missing feature
Map-metaphor components: severity legend, "you are here" scroll marker, field-note expansion cards
Fully keyboard-operable risk zones with a synced ARIA expand/collapse pattern

rules.name: The One Hazard Rule
rules.body: Hazard red is reserved for Critical severity and the brand mark only. Moderate and Worth-noting each carry their own distinct hue (amber-brown, olive) rather than a lighter tint of hazard red — severity tiers are colors apart, not intensities of one color, except within a single zone's own tint ramp.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Not-Severity Rule
rules.body: Focus rings use --focus (#1C5C8A), a blue found nowhere else in the palette, so keyboard focus is never visually confused with a Moderate or Critical tint.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Overpass is reserved for wayfinding scaffolding (brand, headings, tracked labels, legend chrome); system-ui carries every word the user must weigh and trust (document text, quotes, counter-offers). No document prose is ever set in Overpass, and no label/legend chrome is ever set in system-ui.

rules.name: The Tonal-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed by moving one step down the neutral ramp (parchment -> parchment-deep) plus a hairline rule, never by a drop shadow. The single ambient 1px shadow on the field-note card is the sole, deliberately minor exception.

dos: Do set all document prose, quoted source sentences, and counter-offer text in the system-ui body stack — never in Overpass.
Do keep risk-zone shading as flat graduated-opacity red tint, not literal contour lines, inside quoted text — legibility of the source sentence wins that conflict by deliberate decision.
Do make every interactive risk zone keyboard-operable (tabindex, role="button", Enter/Space) and pair every trigger with aria-expanded/aria-controls on its target field note.
Do reserve hazard red for the Critical tier and the brand mark; give Moderate and Worth-noting their own distinct hues rather than lighter tints of hazard red.
Do convey depth with a tonal step (parchment -> parchment-deep) plus a hairline rule; reserve the single ambient 1px shadow for the field-note card only.
donts: Don't introduce a second shadow style, a hard offset shadow, or any neobrutalist block shadow — this world uses one near-invisible ambient hairline shadow and nothing else.
Don't use an icon font or a generic icon library glyph; icons in this build are hand-drawn inline SVG matched to the map metaphor (triangle/diamond/circle severity shapes, the trailhead brand mark).

Don't style body prose or quoted legal text in Overpass, and don't style labels, legend, or headings in the system-ui body stack — the two-voice split is load-bearing for the map/document distinction.
Don't use the --focus blue for anything but :focus-visible outlines; it exists specifically to stay distinct from every severity color.
